_about: SKILL.md skills (the Agent Skills format), the same in both SDKs (gap-closure plan item 1.4, 2026-09-26).
layout: where skills are found and the one name the agent's skill goes by. The two design decisions of the lane are here:
(1) an agent file names SKILL.md skills with `agent_skills:` (a list of folders), never with `skills:`, which names coded skills; `.agents/skills/*` is found on its own;
(2) `webagents skills add <source>` installs into `<agent folder>/.agents/skills/<name>` and records `<agent folder>/.webagents/skills.lock`.
parse_cases: SKILL.md text in, the loaded skill (or the skip) out. `dir` is the folder name, which is the skill's name.

sample: the fixture repository `repo/` (shaped like anthropics/skills) read with `agent_skills: [skills]`; the catalog and activation texts with {pdf_location}, {xlsx_location} and {pdf_dir} filled in by the test.
tools: the three tools, their words and schemas (the enum is the loaded names, sorted), and their scope until `access: tools:` opens them.
scripts, read: how bundled scripts run and files are read, and every refusal.
install: the sources `skills add` accepts, the search rules, the limits, the lock file and the command's words.

activation.already_active: Skill "{name}" is already active in this conversation; its instructions are above.

activate_skill.description: Load the full instructions of one available skill (see <available_skills>) into this conversation. Call it once per skill, before doing what the skill covers; the result also lists the files the skill bundles.

name.description: The skill's name, as listed in <available_skills>.

read_skill_file.description: Read a text file bundled with an activated skill, by its path inside the skill's folder (for example references/api.md). Only files inside that folder can be read.

path.description: The file's path inside the skill's folder.

run_skill_script.description: Run a script bundled with an activated skill inside the sandbox and return its output. script is the path inside the skill's folder (for example scripts/fill_form.py); args are its command-line arguments; a relative path in args resolves against the agent's folder.

script.description: The script's path inside the skill's folder.

timeout.description: Seconds before the script is stopped (default 60, at most 300).

doctor.none: no SKILL.md skills in this folder
doctor.fix: Fix or remove the SKILL.md folders named: {names}
doctor.fix_unnamed: Fix or remove the SKILL.md folders the skills line names
doctor.fix_about: The fix names the folders (2026-09-26; it used to stop at 'named'): `{names}` is the skipped folders, then the skills that warned, comma separated, each once. `fix_unnamed` is the fallback when a folder-level warning names no skill.

install_name.about: The installed folder is named after the skill's own validated `name:` (2026-09-26, the e2e run): it took the repository's name, so a skill declared `greeter` in a repository `greeter-skill` landed as `.agents/skills/greeter-skill` and warned about its own name on every load. A declared name that is not a skill name is not used; the folder name, or the repository's name for a skill at its root, stands in. Read by typescript/tests/unit/cli/skillmd-install-name-e2efix.test.ts and python/tests/cli/test_skillmd_install_name_e2efix.py.

cases.name: a root skill declared under a name other than its repository's
a root skill declaring the repository's own name
a root skill with no name: the repository's
a root skill whose declared name is not a skill name: the repository's
a skill in a subfolder declared under another name
a skill in a subfolder with no name: the folder's

load_messages.agent_skills_not_a_list: agent_skills: must be a list of folder paths

refusals.outside: Access denied: {path} is not a file inside the skill folder
refusals.binary: Access denied: {path} is not a text file
refusals.large: Access denied: {path} is larger than 256 KiB

policy.declared: the agent file's own `sandbox:` policy, with the skill folder added to what a strict policy may read, and always write-denied

refusals.outside: Access denied: {script} is not a file inside the skill folder
refusals.not_runnable: Access denied: {script} is not a script this agent can run (.py, .sh, .js, .mjs, .cjs, or an executable file)
refusals.unrestricted: Access denied: skill scripts run only in a sandbox, and this agent's sandbox is unrestricted, which is no sandbox

messages.no_tty: Pass --yes to install without a prompt.
messages.no_such_skill: No skill called "{name}" in {source}. Skills there: {names}.
messages.too_large_download: Refused: fetching {source} took {size}, more than the 10 MiB limit.
messages.too_large_extracted: Refused: {names} would install {size}, more than the 25 MiB limit.
messages.too_many_files: Refused: {names} would install {count} files, more than the limit of 1000.
messages.symlink: Refused: {name} contains a symbolic link ({path}), which could point outside the skill folder.
messages.exists: {name} already exists in .agents/skills and was not installed by webagents; remove it first.
